# Place

> Place is onchain infrastructure for token economies on Base: token launches with the economy built in, reward campaigns for token and NFT holders, staking programs and NFT collections, all claimable in one place. The hub and launchpad run on Base Sepolia during the testnet.

Read-only data comes from public GET endpoints under `/api/place/*`: JSON, no auth, and ready-to-send transactions (`{ "to", "data", "value" }`) where an action is possible. `chain` defaults to Base Sepolia (`84532`). Never ask a user for a private key or seed phrase.

## Public read API

- `GET /api/place/campaigns?chain=&status=live|upcoming|ended|all`: Reward campaigns for token and NFT holders.
- `GET /api/place/campaign?chain=&hub=&id=[&address=]`: One campaign; with `address`, eligibility, amount, proof and claim status.
- `GET /api/place/claims?chain=&address=`: Everything a wallet can claim, with ready `claimMany` transactions.
- `GET /api/place/token?chain=&address=`: A token or NFT collection and its campaigns.
- `GET /api/place/collections?chain=[&creator=]`: NFT collections created on Place.
- `GET /api/place/launch/tokens?chain=`: Tokens launched on the Place launchpad. Also `launch/token`, `launch/candles`, `launch/trades`, `launch/holders`, `launch/creator`, `launch/stats`.

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/Maksyaka12/place-web): React + Vite app, serverless API and indexer, Foundry hub contracts.
- [Place Launch contracts](https://github.com/Maksyaka12/place-contracts): Foundry launchpad, creator vault and staking contracts.
